title: KHR_character_skeleton_mapping glTF Document Extension
description: Associates roles from externally defined skeletal vocabularies with glTF nodes.

skeletalRigMappings.description: Nonempty dictionary of skeletal vocabulary mappings. Each key is a nonempty mapping-set identifier that names a skeletal vocabulary; each value associates that vocabulary's role identifiers with glTF nodes.

additionalProperties.description: Nonempty role-association dictionary. Each key is a nonempty role identifier; exporters write only identifiers that the mapping set's vocabulary defines, but other keys remain valid. Each value is a role association.
